price.quote: Now launching for pre-order, the MOD Berlin currently carries a promotional price of US $2,199, marked down by $300 from its MSRP.
price.basis: July 2024 launch pricing ($2,499 MSRP); MOD now lists $1,999 regular

cls.quote: In the case of the new MOD Berlin, the bike sports a 750W hub motor and can reach a maximum speed of 28 mph (45 km/h) on pedal assist, maxing out the legally allowable performance specs while staying within Class 3 e-bike regulations (at least, when riders can maintain enough self-discipline to keep the thumb throttle disengaged).

wt.quote: On the mechanical side, the 58 lb (26 kg) electric bike features an aluminum frame with a step-through design and large diameter 29″ wheels.

motor.quote: Motor | MOD DRIVE 750W Geared Hub - 69 Nm of torque

In the case of the new MOD Berlin, the bike sports a 750W hub motor and can reach a maximum speed of 28 mph (45 km/h) on pedal assist, maxing out the legally allowable performance specs while staying within Class 3 e-bike regulations (at least, when riders can maintain enough self-discipline to keep the thumb throttle disengaged).

notes: Maker spec tables are in collapsed accordions (expanded to read). Electrek's July 2024 launch article covers the new (3rd-gen, torque-sensor, 615Wh) MOD Berlin step-through; its 58 lb matches the maker's without-battery weight, so with battery it's 66 lb. Launch MSRP $2,499; now $1,999 regular. MOD also sells a separate 'Berlin 3 Class 1' version (not covered here).
